description: This file defines template classes for managing web transfer operations, including client and server transfer types, within a web framework. It includes classes for handling transfer states, link management, hash calculation, and request/response processing, specifically for Web::Request and Web::Response objects, with support for file-based body content.

classes.name: SingleElementFactoryType
classes.description: A factory class that manages a single element of a specified type, providing access via a proxy.

classes.name: ClientTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing client-side web transfer operations, including state management, request handling, and transfer control for a specified link and file body type.

classes.name: ServerTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing server-side web transfer operations, handling incoming requests, file storage, authorization, and response generation for a specified link and file body type.

methods.name: StartTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer with a given request.

methods.name: CollectInfo
methods.description: Collects information about a source URL.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description: Uploads a file to a destination URL.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a source URL to a destination file.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Virtual method to set up remote URL parameters.

methods.name: InfoCollected
methods.description: Virtual callback invoked when info is collected.

methods.name: Transferred
methods.description: Virtual callback invoked when transfer is completed.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Virtual method to authorize incoming requests.
